notes.title: More than a rhythm game
notes.content: [p]Need a break from the beat? Relax & Recharge in Idol Party II! 🎮💖[/p][p]When you need a breather from rhythm challenges, dive into our vibrant world of chill vibes! ✨[/p][p]📸 Snap & Share: Strike poses with friends at gorgeous photo spots! Capture your best moments.[/p][p]🔍 Explore & Discover: Hunt for hidden treasures across stunning open-world maps![/p][p]🎭 Fun Transformations: Use quirky items to transform into unexpected characters – pure fun![/p][p]🎣 Strategic Fishing: Master the art of fishing! Catch unique fish based on time & location. Build your Fish Encyclopedia![/p][p]Idol Party II is more than just a rhythm game – it's your ultimate social paradise for fun and connection![/p][previewyoutube="bFWi2zp03As;leftthumb"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: 《Idol Party 2 - Love Vibe》Demo launches at Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
[p]We are thrilled to announce that [i]Idol Party 2[/i] will be featured in the [b]Steam Next Fest: October 2025 Edition[/b]! 🎉[/p][p align="start"]During the event, dive into our exclusive demo:

✨ Play a trial version containing [b]70% of the full game's content[/b]!
✨ [b]Unlock exclusive outfits for FREE[/b] and shine as the brightest idol on the dance floor!
✨ [b]Special note[/b]: A selection of [b]rare limited-edition costumes[/b] obtained during the trial may carry over to the full release (details in follow-up announcements).

[b]Duration[/b]: October 13- Qctober 20[/p][p align="start"][b]See you in the world of [i]Idol Party 2[/i]![/b][/p]
